results.gold_answer: Isaac felt the promotional incentives could be more competitive; Mohamed said they'd take the feedback into consideration while refining packages.

answers.answer: Isaac Thompson raised the objection that the pricing and promotional incentives in the proposal for the 2024 Tesla Model S and Porsche 911 Carrera were not competitive enough for wider adoption. results.question: What did Emma Allen want to know about financing and maintenance for the Camry Hybrid, and what did Tariq say about service quality?
results.gold_answer: Emma wanted to ensure the Camry Hybrid was a smart financial decision, asking about financing and maintenance. Tariq said service centers use factory-trained technicians, setting them apart from competitors.

extraction.reason: Tariq Ahmed appears in several calls with Emma Allen, and more than one contains Emma asking about financing and maintenance for the Camry Hybrid plus a Tariq statement on service quality. The 2021-05-24 call is the closest literal match (she explicitly says she is 'curious about financing and maintenance' and asks about service quality), but the 2021-06-02 discovery meeting also contains her asking about service/maintenance, financing, and Tariq describing service quality. These are materially different complete answers.

answers.answer: In the 2021-05-24 call, Emma Allen said she was curious about financing and maintenance for the 2022 Toyota Camry Hybrid because she wanted to ensure it was a smart financial decision. Tariq Ahmed responded that AutoElite offers Flexible Financing Solutions tailored to diverse needs to fit her budget, plus a Comprehensive Maintenance Plan to keep the vehicle running at its best. On service quality, Emma noted she'd heard different things, and Tariq said their service centers employ factory-trained technicians, which sets them apart from competitors because the training keeps them well-versed in the latest models and technology, giving customers confidence in service quality; he added that genuine parts and competitive maintenance plans offer the best value in the market.
